title: Armitage and Superform build a stock-strategy franchise on SuperformOS
summary: [PRESS RELEASE – New York City, USA, November 23rd, 2026] Eight existing SuperStocks strategies move under Armitage’s curation, with SuperformOS providing the operating system behind the products. Armitage, Wintermute’s onchain vault curation arm, and Superform today announced a collaboration that gives holders of tokenized NVIDIA, Tesla, Apple and five other stocks an option beyond holding […]
